cancellation_scope: Pre-stopped participant aborts the barrier. A stop set after entering wait is checked after admission or bounded30-second timeout; it is not promptly polled. Current five sustained callsites supply no stop.
controls: Intentionally late participant cannot admit the other four lanes; all five receive exactly the same action epoch.
Five lane offsets/intervals use a common fake-clock epoch and duration deadline.
Delayed post-admission wakeup does not extend the common duration.
Slow operations retain no catchup pacing.
Missing fifth lane times out and breaks all waiters.
Stop after admission prevents the first operation.
Action failure breaks peers and preserves the action exception.
Default independent pacing/stop behavior and prior slow-operation control remain valid.
Old arrival fingerprints refuse new protocol; matching new fingerprints accept source comparison.
epoch_scope: The five actual callsites each wait once on the same gate; one action sets their common epoch. The underlying Barrier is reusable if a future caller incorrectly reuses this gate.

finding.cause: Each paced lane initialized a separate monotonic epoch on executor entry, so nominal phases did not determine actual relative arrival schedule.

observer_scope: Frozen observer lane.start remains pre-barrier executor entry, not the shared epoch. Actual operation timestamps must validate post-gate alignment.

primary_actual_behavior_before.failure: Deterministic fake clock: late executor entry107.0 with common epoch100.0 incorrectly rebased a0.5-second phase to107.5; expected immediate107.0 because the absolute phase was already due.

qualification: Original failed comparisons preserved. Passing unit controls do not qualify capacity. Parent owns one bounded real ten-second integration validation and any controlled new-baseline experiment.

secondary_before_api_presence.classification: Ten missing-new-gate API/signature failures, separate from actual behavior proof; one old independent default/stop control passed.
